name: Giin Oyako
source:
Main character who wins prefecture governor's elections decides to revenge the good-looking female candidate who caused his father death. She has a daughter - well, that's too bad for her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
赢得都知事选举的主角决定向害死他父亲的漂亮女候选人报仇。她有一个女儿——好吧，这对她来说太糟糕了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
